title: Task 6: Build a Context-Aware Chat Assistant with Memory
summary: This lesson guides you through building a simple AI chat assistant that remembers previous messages and uses conversation history as context. You will learn how to maintain memory and build context so the AI can have a continuous conversation rather than responding independently.

sections.text: Scene: A developer's screen displays a simple AI chat assistant diagram showing conversation history flowing into a language model. The color scheme is a calm blue interface with glowing text blocks representing user messages and AI responses. I wonder...?: How do we make an AI remember previous messages instead of treating every prompt independently? Answer: We load an LLM using a Python library such as Hugging Face Transformers and store conversation history to send back as context.

Scene: A flowchart diagram highlights three connected steps: loading a language model, maintaining conversation memory, and building context for each prompt. The boxes are arranged sequentially to show the continuous chat loop. I wonder...?: What specific features are required to build this system? Answer: The required features include loading a language model, maintaining conversation memory for user messages and AI responses, building context by combining previous history with new user questions, and running a continuous chat loop.

learning_objectives: Load an LLM using a Python library such as Hugging Face Transformers
Build a chat loop where the user can ask multiple questions and store conversation history
Inject the previous conversation as context in each new prompt to observe how memory affects responses

vocabulary.definition: An AI model loaded using a Python library like Hugging Face Transformers to generate responses.
Stored history of user messages and AI responses that allows the system to maintain a conversation.
